title: The Ultimate Survival Modpack
description: TUSM is Minecraft turned up to nightmare mode. Explore 5 dimensions (yep, including End and Nether, duh) and face crazy bosses like Sandworm, Void Worm and the Warped Mosco. It’s chaos, it’s deadly, and it will make you scream… probably a lot, lol.
body:
TUSM is NOT the Minecraft you know. This world is alive, evil, and lowkey hates you. Seasons change, weather can literally punch you, and you have to watch your hunger, thirst, AND where you sleep or you’re DEAD. Mess up once and poof, game over. You can’t just run in like a noob lol. Planning sucks but dying is worse

Go explore forests, mountains, deserts, and ice biomes that all want to kill you in their own special ways. Go underground for caves, dungeons, traps, and monsters that will make you scream like a little baby. Then go even further into crazy dimensions that make you question why you even play games. Dragons, sandworms, and stuff that is literally out to get you. Bosses will make you cry, rage, and probably throw your keyboard across the room.

![a cave](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1697cf0b06fd96ffea1a2aa45e8fb14f23de0599.png)
(using photon)

Farming, cooking, and crafting actually MATTER. You can’t just plant a potato and pray. Make potions, cook meals, pick your weapons and armor carefully. The weather and seasons love to mess with you just for fun. Adapt or become worm food

Every single day in TUSM is a chance to die in the most ridiculous ways. Even “safe” forests are sketchy. One tiny mistake and all your stuff is gone forever. But if you survive, the loot is insane—relics, rare treasures, and bragging rights for days. TUSM is hard, chaotic, hilarious, and will make you scream, rage, and question your life choices nonstop. Explore, fight, survive, rage, repeat. YOU WILL DIE. YOU WILL CRY. YOU WILL LOVE IT.
